## How to fix

| Class | Meaning | Fix with |
|---|---|---|
| V1 | Raw color literal (hex / rgb() / rgba() / hsl()) outside a var() fallback | `color.*` → `var(--color-*)`; legal fallback only inside `var(--token, #hex)` |
| V2 | Raw duration or cubic-bezier inside `transition:` / `animation:` | `motion.duration.*` + `motion.easing.*` → `var(--motion-duration-*)` / `var(--motion-easing-*)` |
| V3 | Raw numeric `z-index` | `z.*` → `var(--z-base|raise|content|sticky|bar|overlay|sheet|drawer|popover|canvas|toast|menu|max)` |
| V4 | Raw `border-radius` (px/%/rem or bare 0) | `radius.*` → `var(--radius-none|xs|sm|md|card|lg|xl|pill|circle)` |
| V5 | Inline `style="…"` attribute carrying color or px radius | Move to a class in `<style>`; paint via `var(--color-*)`, radius via `var(--radius-*)` |
| V6 | SVG paint attribute `fill|stroke|stop-color="#…"` | `var(--color-*)` in a CSS rule (`fill:var(--color-…)`) or a token-backed class |
| V7 | Raw px border width in `border` / `border-top|right|bottom|left` | `border.width.*` → `var(--border-width-hairline|strong|accent)` as the width position of the shorthand |
| V8 | Raw px/rem number inside a `padding` / `margin` / `gap` declaration (incl. `-top|-right|-bottom|-left|-block|-inline`, `row-gap`, `column-gap`) | `0`, `auto` and percentages pass; `spacing.*` → `var(--spacing-2|2xs|6|xs|10|sm|14|md|18|20|lg|xl|2xl)`; layout-scale and off-grid values get an in-place `lint-allow` reason |
| U1 | Dead `var(--name)`: not defined in tokens.css and not declared in this page | Add the token to `design-system/tokens.json` → regenerate, or use the existing token; never rely on a fallback |
| T1 | Raw numeric `font-size`, or a literal size inside the `font:` shorthand | `typography.size.*` → `var(--typography-size-*)`; `font:` shorthand takes `var(--typography-size-*)/var(--line-height-*)` |
| T2 | Raw numeric `line-height`, or a literal leading inside the `font:` shorthand | `typography.lineheight.*` → `var(--line-height-*)` once the scale exists |
| T3 | Raw `letter-spacing` value | `typography.tracking.*` → `var(--typography-tracking-*)` |
| T4 | Raw numeric `font-weight`, or a literal family stack | `typography.weight.*` / `typography.family.*` → `var(--typography-weight-*)` / `var(--typography-family-*)` |
| T8 | Token defined in the `:root` contract with no consumer (product page, `themes` map cell, or `components.css`) | Wire it in `index/pitch/engine.html`, in a theme map, or `components.css` — or delete it; gallery swatches do not count |
| T9 | Two role names resolving to one value: in the token set, or in one theme map and family | Alias one name to the other (`--other`) and remove the duplicate role; a slot that legitimately has no own value is declared `null` |
| T10 | Role contract parity: a map missing a slot, a slot outside the contract, or an emitted block with the wrong role-var count | Declare all 14 slots in every map (null where a theme has no value) and regenerate; nulls are explicit, not gaps |
| T11 | Token `type` does not match its `value` shape (an alias `var(--other)` is skipped — the target is judged) | Fix the type or the value in `tokens.json` → regenerate |
| T13 | Two literal values in one `:root` (an alias `var(--other)` is skipped — it is a pointer, not a second truth) | Delete the redundant alias and keep one role name |
| T14 | `!important` | Fix the cascade; `!important` is an escalation, not a style |
| T15 | Inline `style=` attribute | Move to a class in `<style>`; budget is per file |

### Exemptions (`lint-allow`)

A hit may be tolerated only **in place, on the same line, with a reason**: `/* lint-allow: reason */` in CSS, `// lint-allow: reason` in JS, `<!-- lint-allow: reason -->` in HTML. The marker clears every hit on its own line (V1–V8, U1 and the budgeted T classes) and nothing on the next line. The reason must be at least 8 characters after trimming; a marker with no reason, or with `ok`, exempts nothing — the hit stays a violation and is additionally reported as **BAD-ALLOW**, so the mechanism cannot silently blanket-suppress.

Legitimate only where **a browser cannot resolve the value from a custom property**: the `meta` theme-color tag, `@media` / `@supports` conditions, and canvas or gradient string composites assembled in JS. Never legitimate for any color, duration, radius, border width, spacing step or `z-index` that a token could hold — those get a token (or get fixed), because that is exactly the drift this gate exists to catch.

### Documented exceptions

- Media-query breakpoints stay raw px (`var()` is invalid in `@media`).
- `design-system/tokens.css` is the token source and is never scanned.
- Page-local alias declarations in `:root` are legal when they resolve to a token: `--bg:var(--color-wiki-light-bg)`. `--spacing-*` is the only scale that may hold rhythm.
- A hex color is legal only as a `var()` fallback: `var(--color-x, #fff)`.
- Spacing is a 2px grid: `padding`/`margin`/`gap` take `var(--spacing-2|2xs|6|xs|10|sm|14|md|18|20|lg|xl|2xl)` or `0`/`auto`/a percentage. `width`, `height`, `top`, `left`, `inset`, `transform` and `grid-template` are geometry and stay out of V8.
- Layout-scale padding above 48px, negative offsets, and off-grid values (22.4, 25.6, 41.6, 86.4, 118) that would move more than 0.9px are kept literal with an in-place `lint-allow` reason.
- Budgets are ceilings, not exemptions: the count measured on 2026-11-24 stays visible, no file is excluded from any check, and a count below budget is progress. Only the excess fails `--check`.
- `T8` counts `var()` references inside `<style>`/`<script>` of the three product pages, every `themes` map cell, and `design-system/components.css` when it exists; `design-system/index.html` is the system's own documentation and never counts as a consumer. Aliases (`value: var(--other)`) and `breakpoint.*` are exempt.
- `T9` compares colors across the whole set but dimensions only between step names of one scale (`spacing.base ≡ spacing.2xs`), because `spacing.xs` and `radius.sm` both being 8px is two scales, not two roles. Role slots are compared only inside one theme map and one family, so the same warning color in two themes is a palette prior, not a duplicate role.
- `T10` asserts the role contract: 14 slots in all four maps, nulls explicit, the fall-through covering exactly the null set, and one emitted block per map with 17 − nulls role vars. Themes legitimately differ in nulls (pitch 2, wiki-light 5, wiki-dark 5, engine 3).
- `T11` validates the 9 canonical types; `other` is gone from the source and is rejected by the generator. A `var()` alias value is skipped (it is a pointer; the target keeps its own row).
- `T15` is budgeted per file (index 19, pitch 31, engine 2, gallery 148) so inline styles cannot migrate into the largest page without failing.
